def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # maximal monochromatic straight runs in each of 4 orientations; paint entire diagonal line both ways until blocked
    cells=[(g[i][j],i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    slopes=[(1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(1,-1)]

            run=[cell]; seen.add((i,j)); ii,jj=i,j

def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    cells=[(g[i][j],i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    slopes=[(1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(1,-1)]
    for dr,dc in slopes:
        seen=set()
        for cell in cells:
            v,i,j=cell
            if (i,j) in seen: continue
            run=[cell]; seen.add((i,j)); ii,jj=i,j
            while True:
                ni,nj=ii+dr,jj+dc
                if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W and g[ni][nj]==v:
                    run.append((g[ni][nj],ni,nj)); seen.add((ni,nj)); ii,jj=ni,nj
                else: break
            if len(run)<2: continue
            col=run[0][0]
            for sign in (1,-1):
                p=run[-1] if sign==1 else run[0]
                r,c=p[1],p[2]
                nr,nc=r+sign*dr,c+sign*dc
                while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and out[nr][nc]==bg:
                    out[nr][nc]=col; nr+=sign*dr; nc+=sign*dc
    return out

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    best=None
    dirs=[(1,1),(1,-1)]
    # collect runs keyed by slope & line position
    cand=[]
    for dr,dc in dirs:
        seen=set()
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if g[i][j]==bg or (i,j) in seen: continue
                v=g[i][j]; run=[(v,i,j)]; ii,jj=i,j
                while 0<=ii+dr<H and 0<=jj+dc<W and g[ii+dr][jj+dc]==v:
                    run.append((v,ii+dr,jj+dc)); ii+=dr; jj+=dc
                if len(run)<2: continue
                seen.update(p[1:] for p in run)
                def dist(p):
                    nr,nc=p[1]+dr,p[2]+dc
                    s=0
                    while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]==bg:
                        s+=1; nr+=dr; nc+=dc
                    return s
                d1,d2=dist(run[-1]),dist(run[0])
                cand.append(((run,col:=run[0][0],d1+d2,dr,dc),col,d1,d2))
    if not cand: return out
    cand.sort(key=lambda x:x[0], reverse=True)

                while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and out[rr][cc]==bg:

                v=g[i][j]; run=[(v,i,j)]; ii,jj=i,j
                while 0<=ii+dr<H and 0<=jj+dc<W and g[ii+dr][jj+dc]==v:

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    runs=[]; seen=set()
    for dr,dc in [(1,1),(1,-1)]:
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if g[i][j]==bg or (i,j) in seen: continue
                v=g[i][j]; run=[(v,i,j)]; ii,jj=i,j
                while 0<=ii+dr<H and 0<=jj+dc<W and g[ii+dr][jj+dc]==v:
                    run.append((v,ii+dr,jj+dc)); ii+=dr; jj+=dc
                if len(run)<2: continue
                seen.update(p[1:] for p in run); runs.append((v,run,dr,dc))
    changed=False
    for v,run,dr,dc in runs:
        fwd = run[-1]; e1=fwd[1]+dr, fwd[2]+dc
        bwd = run[0]; e2=bwd[1]-dr, bwd[2]-dc
        sf=0; nb=0
        n,e=e1,e2
        while 0<=n<H and 0<=e<W and g[n][e]==bg: sf+=1; n+=dr; e+=dc
        sb=0; n,e=e2,e1
        while 0<=n<H and 0<=e<W and g[n][e]==bg: sb+=1; n-=dr; e-=dc
        # choose direction(s): prefer the direction with more room; paint if total>=2
        s1=sf; s2=sb
        if s1+s2==0: continue
        dirs_to_paint = ((1,dr,dc),(-1,-dr,-dc)) if s1>s2 else ((-1,-dr,-dc),(1,dr,dc)) if s2>s1 else ((1,dr,dc),(-1,-dr,-dc))
        for sg,a,b in dirs_to_paint:
            nr,nc=(run[-1][1],run[-1][2]) if sg==1 else (run[0][1],run[0][2])
            # adjust: start just beyond the end cell
            rr,cc=nr+a,b+b
            while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]==bg:
                out[rr][cc]=v; rr+=sg*a; cc+=sg*b
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f3(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    runs=[]; seen=set()
    for dr,dc in [(1,1),(1,-1)]:
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if g[i][j]==bg or (i,j) in seen: continue
                v=g[i][j]; run=[(v,i,j)]; ii,jj=i,j
                while 0<=ii+dr<H and 0<=jj+dc<W and g[ii+dr][jj+dc]==v:
                    run.append((v,ii+dr,jj+dc)); ii+=dr;jj+=dc
                if len(run)>=2:
                    seen.update(p[1:] for p in run); runs.append((v,run,dr,dc))
    for v,run,dr,dc in runs:
        cands=[]
        dirs=[(dr,dc),(-dr,-dc)]
        ends=[('first',(run[-1][1],run[-1][2])),('last',(run[0][1],run[0][2]))]
        for mode,(r,c) in ends:
            # choose direction that maximizes room (not immediately blocked)
            for sign,dirv in enumerate(dirs):
                n,nm=n=None
                n,r_,c_=r,c
                n+=dirv[0]; c_+=dirv[1]; s=0
                blocked=True
                while 0<=n<H and 0<=c_<W and g[n][c_]==bg:
                    s+=1; n+=dirv[0]; c_+=dirv[1]
                # blocked here means the immediate neighbor is non-bg or OOB -> cannot extend this way from this end? but demo2 fwd had dist 0 yet painted bwd
                if s>=0: pass
                cands.append((s,mode,dirv))
        # prefer direction with max room that has some room; else nothing
        best=max(cands,key=lambda x:x[0])
        mode,dirv=best[1],best[2]
        if best[0]<1: continue
        rr,cc=(run[-1][1],run[-1][2]) if mode=='first' else (run[0][1],run[0][2])
        n=rr+dirv[0]; c=cc+dirv[1]
        while 0<=n<H and 0<=c<W and g[n][c]==bg:
            out[n][c]=v; n+=dirv[0]; c+=dirv[1]
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seen=set()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==bg or (i,j) in seen: continue
            v=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
            while stack:
                r,c=stack.pop(); cells.append((r,c)); seen.add((r,c))
                for dr,dc in [(1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(1,-1)]:
                    nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]==v and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                        stack.append((nr,nc))
            # diagonal/run direction: sign of (min/max) diffs
            rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
            dr=(max(rs)-min(rs)); dc=(max(cs)-min(cs))
            n,dg=cells[-1][0],cells[-1][1]
            ext=False
            # forward
            n,c=cells[-1]
            while 0<=n+dg<H and 0<=c+dg* (dc or 1)/dr if dr else 0<=c+dc<W and g[n+dg if dr else n][c+(dc if dc else 0)]==bg:
                pass
            # simpler: extend along both axis-aligned directions first, then diagonal? Just: direction vector = (sign(dr), sign(dc)) but if one is 0 handle separately
            dd=(1 if dr else 0, 1 if dc else 0)
            def ray(n,c,sgn):
                n+=sgn[0]*dd[0]; c+=sgn[1]*dd[1]
                ok=True
                while 0<=n<H and 0<=c<W and g[n][c]==bg:
                    out[n][c]=v; n+=sgn[0]*dd[0]; c+=sgn[1]*dd[1]
                return ok
            ray(0,0,(1,0)); ray(0,0,(-1,0)); ray(0,0,(0,1)); ray(0,0,(0,-1))
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
